landing.hero_subtitle: Direct scholarships, vocational pathways, and clear career guidance for rural students — in their mother tongue.
landing.why_heading: Most students don't lack ambition. They lack information.
landing.why_p1: When a student in a rural school finishes 10th grade, their family rarely knows about local government ITI wireman seats, polytechnic computer diplomas, or fee reimbursement schemes.
landing.why_p2: DreamCatcher turns that around in 15 minutes. Volunteers walk into rural schools, sit down with students, and give them clear, honest, actionable pathways.
landing.pillar_1_title: We speak like an elder sibling, not a government bureaucrat.
landing.pillar_1_desc: Clear audio explanations in native dialects. No complicated forms or confusing administrative jargon.
landing.pillar_2_title: We match actual scholarships before deadlines pass.
landing.pillar_2_desc: Automatic matching for state DBT, Post-Matric welfare waivers, and tribal hostels so financial hardship doesn't stop education.
landing.pillar_3_title: Works even when there is zero mobile signal.
landing.pillar_3_desc: Camps run deep in hilly and tribal villages. Intakes save directly onto the volunteer's phone and sync when back in town.
landing.demo_subtitle: Choose a real student case below to see how DreamCatcher gives immediate, realistic advice.
landing.cta_box_title: Ready to guide students in your village?
landing.cta_box_desc: No technical expertise needed. Sign in with your Volunteer ID, register students in seconds, and start counseling.
